body: CANDIDATE READY FOR CHIEF OR PEER REVIEW: 32f4c72c0e7a360f1c188204c8692b9c66ba4db1, parent d295f4cd67a472d5a0cc295e1c163f5e97805e2b, tree 5a77af3293ae0324ad85803f9146455df62a81d4. It is an isolated nine-path candidate and has NOT been landed on StoryAtlas main. A generic renderer-neutral InteractionDecoration distinguishes Selection versus Focus and Direct versus Proxy while retaining original and visible semantic keys; Intaglio remains unaware of narrative identity. AppCompiler now consumes the exact OnMark, ViaAncestor, and OffProjection placements on both Atlas and Codex and fails closed when a claimed direct or proxy placement has no render target. Codex direct treatment uses exactAnnotationsFor, never ancestor fallback. SVG and DOM styling distinguish direct and proxy through non-colour patterns; proxy accessible labels name original and visible addresses and never set aria-pressed or aria-current as though the ancestor were selected. Exact committed-tree source-pinned compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS passed 112 tests. Exact artifact browser smoke passed the full semantic-zoom path, proxy truthfulness, OffProjection absence, direct restoration, canonical text, identity, accessibility, and zero console/page errors; browser audits were clean before and after. Two mutations were killed: collapsing ViaAncestor into Direct and removing proxy targets. Scala type-discipline review is clean. Requesting disposition before main is advanced.
